newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries extend rally, T-bond yld at 6.70 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries extend rally, T-bond yld at 6.70 pct.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries extended gains in late afternoon trade on continued buying after the release of a lower-than-expected Employment Cost Index (ECI) triggered a strong rally, analysts said.
By 1450 EST/1950 GMT, the 6-3/4 percent 30-year benchmark Treasury bond was quoted up 1-26/32 at 100-22/32. Its yield dropped to 6.70 percent, the lowest level since the August 12 close.
The Employment Cost Index released on Tuesday posted a 0.6 percent rise against an expected 0.8 percent jump.
The report suggested inflation pressures remain mostly tame, bolstering the view that the Federal Reserve might keep interest rates unchanged at its November 13 meeting.
"The market got the news it was hoping for," said Kevin Flanagan, economist at Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, referring to the market-friendly ECI report.
A drop in consumer confidence to 106.2 in October from 111.8 in September also provided underpinning.
